senses.sense_definition: Any of the large, hairy spiders belonging to the family Theraphosidae, often kept as pets.

examples.text: Many people keep a <w>tarantula</w> as a pet because they are fascinating to watch.
The <w>tarantula</w> is a large, hairy spider that lives in many parts of the world.

senses.sense_definition: A large spider, often belonging to the infraorder Mygalomorphae, sometimes mistakenly called by this name.

examples.text: Some people call large huntsman spiders a <w>tarantula</w> due to their size.
The stadium roof looks like a giant metal <w>tarantula</w> sitting over the city.

senses.sense_definition: A type of wolf spider from southern Europe, historically associated with a dancing mania called tarantism.

examples.text: In the past, people believed the bite of a <w>tarantula</w> caused a strange urge to dance.
The original <w>tarantula</w> is a wolf spider found in the Mediterranean region.

traits.comment: Refers to historical folklore regarding the spider.
